translations.web: a devout man, and one who feared God with all his house, who gave gifts for the needy generously to the people, and always prayed to God.
translations.bsb: He and all his household were devout and God-fearing. He gave generously to the people and prayed to God regularly.
translations.kjv: A devout man, and one that feared God with all his house, which gave much alms to the people, and prayed to God alway.
translations.asv: a devout man, and one that feared God with all his house, who gave much alms to the people, and prayed to God always.
